profile.bio: A motivated and enthusiastic student with a strong academic background and an interest in practical learning. Possesses good communication, teamwork, and organizational skills, and gains valuable professional experience

hobby.description: Walking outdoors and observing plants, insects and birds in their natural environment - the hobby that made Applied Biology feel like the right course for me.
Music keeps me focused during study sessions and relaxed after long laboratory days. It is the soundtrack to most of my revision.
Taking photos of people, places and nature - including the two portraits on this website. I enjoy capturing colour and light on an ordinary day.
Reading beyond the coursework - books and articles about the human body, plants and the environment that deepen what we cover in class.
Working with classmates on group assignments and practicals. Teamwork is one of my core skills, and group study makes difficult topics easier.
Looking after plants at home and watching them grow - a small, everyday way of practising the observation skills I use in biology practicals.

movie.title: A Different World
movie.why_i_love_it: Life at Hillman College, a fictional historically Black university — friendships, ambition, love and growing up away from home. As a university student myself, the campus stories, the humour and Whitley and Dwayne's journey feel close to real student life.

movie.title: Euphoria
movie.why_i_love_it: Zendaya stars as Rue in HBO's raw, emotional drama about youth, identity, addiction and friendship. The storytelling is honest and hard-hitting, and the visuals are striking — a show that stays with you long after each episode ends.
